text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen about 9% from Period 1 despite a brief recovery, so I should be prepared for volatility and avoid reacting to short-term moves.","I have made no trades so far; before changing anything, I should understand my holdings, cash, and overall concentration and risk.","Because I check only a few times a year and rarely trade, I should use periodic reviews to keep decisions aligned with my long-term goals rather than trade frequently."]}
